response.sql:
WITH media_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    m.Name,
    SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL(18,2))) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) as rate,
    COUNT(t.TrackId) as track_count
  FROM MediaType m
  INNER JOIN Track t ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.Name
),
mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) as mean_rate
  FROM media_stats
)
SELECT 
  ms.Name,
  ms.rate,
  ms.track_count,
  ms.rate - mr.mean_rate as rate_minus_mean
FROM media_stats ms
CROSS JOIN mean_rate mr
WHERE ms.rate > mr.mean_rate;

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded from both the rate calculation and the track count, since they cannot contribute to the sum of bytes and would prevent meaningful rate calculation.

alternatives.interpretation: Count all tracks in each media type (including those with NULL Bytes) rather than only those with Bytes data used in the rate calculation.
alternatives.sql:
WITH all_tracks AS (
  SELECT m.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) as track_count
  FROM MediaType m
  INNER JOIN Track t ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.Name
),
track_rates AS (
  SELECT m.Name,
    SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL(18,2))) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) as rate
  FROM MediaType m
  INNER JOIN Track t ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.Name
),
mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) as mean_rate FROM track_rates
)
SELECT at.Name, tr.rate, at.track_count,
  tr.rate - mr.mean_rate as rate_minus_mean
FROM all_tracks at
INNER JOIN track_rates tr ON at.Name = tr.Name
CROSS JOIN mean_rate mr
WHERE tr.rate > mr.mean_rate;
